Additionally, it doesn't properly handle edge cases like empty text or trailing whitespace.

```python
def sentence_count(text):
    """Count sentences. A sentence ends with . ! or ?; trailing text without one also counts."""
    if not text:
        return 0
    # Split on sentence-ending punctuation and filter out empty parts
    parts = [p for p in re.split(r"[.!?]+", text) if p.strip()]
    return len(parts)
```
